SELECT seq_product_img.nextval FROM dual
INSERT INTO product_img ( product_img_no, product_no, image_url, image_type, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{productImgNo}, #{productNo}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageType}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT product_img_no AS productImgNo, product_no AS productNo, image_url AS imageUrl, image_type AS imageType, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM product_img WHERE product_no = #{productNo} AND image_type IN ('MAIN', 'THUMB') ORDER BY CASE image_type WHEN 'MAIN' THEN 1 WHEN 'THUMB' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, sort_order ASC
